spans.text: ...Whum.
Found it! This is a Sangvis reserve outpost, and...
The unit signals here are really weak. Looks like hardly anyone's guarding it...
For safety's sake, I'll expand my detection radius.
...SOP-II looks closely at the electronic map.
The enemies...are all above the base. What are they doing?
Eh, who cares, all I need is to steal a power supply anyway. This is a great opportunity!
Looks like we'll be able to see each other again soon, RO! Now, all we need to do is pinpoint the loc—
...Whum.
Just then, SOP-II notices several Griffin signals on the map.
Are those...
Griffin T-Dolls?
Don't tell me...
They're the forces from the resupply point who got surrounded by Sangvis Ferri and were forced to flee?
And then S.F. left their own base to chase them...
...SOP-II hesitates.
Keep calm and think, SOP-II...
What would RO do?
She'd say, "Our friends are surrounded by S.F., and they're about to be wiped out."
"We must save them no matter how dangerous it is. We're allies on the battlefield."
Yeah, she'd definitely say that.
But...these Dolls can back their neural clouds up, right? And I only have one shot at this...
RO isn't awake yet, and I don't have a command module either...
I'm all alone, while S.F. must surely have a Ringleader with them...
Nobody's going to take responsibility for my actions. Would it be safer to find a backup power source first...?
Ahhhhhhhhhh what a pain—!
Why do I have to make choices like these?! I'm not a team leader, and I haven't been given any orders either!
I... What should I do...?
...SOP-II stands in place, but the world does not answer.
Ah, whatever, I'll just head out first...
That's right, I'll head out first and think about it later!
If you choose to rescue the Griffin T-Dolls, you will need to eliminate all enemies to buy time for them.
If you capture the enemy command post, you will be considered to have abandoned the rescue and left the battlefield.
Your decision will affect the plot progression, so please choose wisely.

Once you complete an objective, you will not be able to proceed to other, uncleared routes until an end is reached. You will only be allowed to pick a new choice by backtracking. Routes you have already cleared will always be available.
